env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# An interpolated string or option default lowered inside a call the
# MustNonNil wrapper covers must nest inside the wrapper, not overlap
# it. The wrapped call stores a Go package's pointer result into a
# declared non-nil location; the interpolation and option lowerings
# run after the wrapper, so their splices land strictly inside the
# wrapper span. The LoGOs-to-LoGOs calls are controls that take no
# wrapper.

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^webtest\.invalid Test invalid fault\.$'
stdout '^webtest\.plain plain message$'
stdout '^webtest\.plain fallback$'
stdout '^reader invalid of 2$'
stdout '^reader fallback$'
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectwrap

go 1.27

-- m/lib/error.lgo --
package lib

type Kind uint8

const (
	Invalid Kind = iota + 1
)

func (k Kind) String() string {
	if k == Invalid {
		return "invalid"
	}
	return "unknown"
}

type Code string

type Error struct {
	Code    Code
	Kind    Kind
	Message string
}

func New(code Code, kind Kind, message string) *Error {
	return &Error{Code: code, Kind: kind, Message: message}
}

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/ejectwrap/lib"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func local(kind lib.Kind) *lib.Error {
	return lib.New(lib.Code($"webtest.{kind.String()}"), kind, $"Test {kind.String()} fault.")
}

func plain(kind lib.Kind) *lib.Error {
	return lib.New("webtest.plain", kind, "plain message")
}

func withDefault(kind lib.Kind, name string?) *lib.Error {
	return lib.New("webtest.plain", kind, name ?? "fallback")
}

func readerOf(kind lib.Kind) *strings.Reader {
	return strings.NewReader($"reader {kind.String()} of {int(kind) + 1}")
}

func readerOr(name string?) *strings.Reader {
	return strings.NewReader(name ?? "reader fallback")
}

func show(e *lib.Error) {
	fmt.Println(e.Code, e.Message)
}

func showReader(r *strings.Reader) {
	var sb strings.Builder
	if _, err := r.WriteTo(&sb); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("error", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(sb.String())
}

func main() {
	show(local(lib.Invalid))
	show(plain(lib.Invalid))
	show(withDefault(lib.Invalid, nil))
	showReader(readerOf(lib.Invalid))
	showReader(readerOr(nil))
}
